arriving together, discovering Jena, meeting new people
International students Welcome Days Uni Jena Sept. 2017 Botanical Garden
Image: Christoph Worsch (University of Jena)
Welcome to Jena – meet new people and get started together!
Logo Thuringia is open to the world
Graphic: Intitiative thueringen-weltoffen.de
A diverse programme offers all new students many opportunities to get to know other students, the city and the University of Jena.
It is organised by the International Office in close cooperation with many student groups and other institutions and is open to all students.
Programme of the Welcome Days: 28/09 - 31/10/2026
All events are included in the
events calendar
(steadily updated).

WelcomeCafé at the International Centre
The Welcome Café always takes place in the International Centre during the Welcome Days. It is organised by international students and is aimed at new (international) students. At the WelcomeCafé, you can meet other new students and get
tips on studying and living
in Jena. Our workshops provide information on the topics of finding accommodation, visa application, study organization and much more. The WelcomeCafé team helps new students wit their
questions about the enrolment
.
Opening hours:
Monday to Friday 15:00-17:00
28.09. - 16.10.2026
Please also note these and many other events in the
calendar
.
